scope: code-owned scheduler workflow controls for production cron fallbacks

controls.name: Required scheduler fallback workflows exist
controls.proof: All required production scheduler fallback workflow files are present for pool settlement, match alerts, LiveScore football sync, and weekly game-pack generation.

controls.name: Operations schedule and dispatch controls are enforced
controls.proof: Workflows have explicit scheduled triggers plus manual dispatch fallback, main-branch gating, production-operations approval, and non-overlapping concurrency groups.

controls.name: Scheduler credentials are referenced as secrets only
controls.proof: SUPABASE_URL and CRON_SECRET are read from GitHub secrets with preflight checks; no credential-like values are stored in workflow files.

controls.name: Scheduler targets match deployed Edge jobs
controls.proof: Workflow targets and payload markers match settle-match-pools, dispatch-match-alerts, sync-livescore-football, and generate-weekly-game-packs.

controls.name: Platform cron manifest matches scheduler expectations
controls.proof: A credential-free platform-cron manifest defines provider, cadence, target Edge function, payload, max lag, severity, and pending provider activation evidence for each required scheduler job.

controls.name: Code-owned scheduler history and missed-run snapshot exist
controls.proof: Scheduled Edge jobs use a shared cron audit helper, backend-only cron run-history RPCs, seeded scheduler expectations, an admin-only missed-run health snapshot contract, linked SQL proof, and linked Edge deployment inventory.

controls.name: Credential-safe post-deploy audit smoke tooling exists
controls.proof: A credential-safe post-deploy smoke runner and validator proved deployed scheduler Edge functions return tracked database audit run ids without writing credential values to evidence.

controls.name: Provider scheduler state is captured without credentials
controls.proof: GitHub Actions provider workflow state and recent scheduled-run history are captured in credential-free evidence, with run ids hashed and launch blocked when provider state is not ready.

controls.name: Provider history remains an external launch gate
controls.proof: This code-owned proof validates repository scheduler controls and database-backed run-history support only; provider run history, delivered alert evidence, and owner signoff remain required.
